notes: Read all 20 clubs from their Penn Clubs directory entries and checked each club's own website once where one is listed. Two sites redirected and were followed once (barsorg.com and bmes.seas.upenn.edu). Result: 14 records are publishable and 6 are held back as status unknown: Bangla Society, Beekeeping Club, BioArt Lab, Bioethics Society, BGSA and Black Student League. The six are held because the directory status reads INACTIVE and no dated activity was found on a club site. Directory status words such as UNDER REVIEW and PRELIMINARY were read as registration state, not activity, so clubs with the directory active flag and no dated item are probably_active. Active on dated evidence: Ballet at Penn (show dated April 2026 on its site), Beyond Arrests (posts dated November 2025, read from web addresses), Blockchain at Penn (March 27 and 28, 2026 event weekend), Body Empowerment (Fall 2026 recruitment, year only). Probably active on a dated 2024 post: Black Graduate and Professional Student Assembly (post dates read from web addresses). The Black Student League website did not resolve and was not retried. Personal emails and phone numbers of officers on directory entries and club sites were not recorded. Directory emails that look like individual Penn addresses were left out. The Bulgarian Society directory Instagram link uses an account name that does not match the club, so it was left out. Linktree pages (Bangla Society, BlackGen Capital, BioArt Lab) were not read because they are link lists. No WebSearch was used. Fetches: 43, under the cap of 60. No rate limiting was seen.
